result:
I’d make the path of least resistance in the world more often be the path of care.

Not by forcing anyone to be good, but by removing the hidden costs people can pretend don’t exist—the costs of cruelty, indifference, and short-term gain on the people who can’t protect themselves.

If acting kindly were often easier, safer, and more attractive than hurting, the world would change everywhere at once.
